left.item: E3 says less than the Lean holds: mutual dependence already gives the condition, held de se along being affected, in one theorem (medium)
left.why: `Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted` (MutualDependence.lean:139) proves Unrestricted (bounded fun q => L.WithinInfluence W (center q)) from L.MutuallyDependent W. By the definitions (Retaining.lean:58 bounded; Feedback.lean:175 WithinInfluence = WithinClosure (L.AffectedBy W); Weightings.lean:1503 and 1532 selfAscribed and ownClosure), that is Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure (L.AffectedBy W)) center): the continuation condition held de se along what can affect each center, with no step. 05's theorem paragraph says it ('Under each reading, significance bounded by the matching closure of each center is the continuation condition'), and so does the opening's own [^present]. So [^axiom]'s 'the two are not yet joined into one theorem' is true only of the reach-closure pair it names. Its lead, 'that where relations close holding one's own continuation needs no step, proved in steps not yet joined into one theorem', says less than is proved, and so do 07's thesis ('though that this gives the condition is not yet stated as one theorem') and 07 §4 ('rests on two theorems not yet joined into one'). What is not one theorem is the chain on to C (Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted, then Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn at rel := L.AffectedBy W), so the screen's how-far clause stays true. Not fixed: E3 directs this wording on every front, and 07 belongs to the ch07 agent. The coordinator decides for all fronts at once, and checks what the separate session card proposes. A possible wording for [^axiom]: 'where every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other, the condition held de se along what can affect each center holds (`Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted`, 05), and every reach closure is the whole too (`Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_reach`)'; lead: '... needs no step, proved'.
